subject: ela
intro: Analyze and evaluate the effectiveness of structure.

items.prompt:
How an author arranges the parts of a text is its:
A) structure
B) font
C) length

Judging how WELL a structure works is to:
A) evaluate it
B) ignore it
C) rename it

An effective structure makes an argument's points:
A) clear and convincing
B) hidden
C) confusing

A report runs problem, then causes, then evaluated solutions. This structure is EFFECTIVE because it:
A) clarifies the problem and causes before proposing and judging solutions
B) hides the problem
C) bores the reader
items.answer: A) clarifies the problem and causes before proposing and judging solutions

solution.answer: A) clarifies the problem and causes before proposing and judging solutions

items.prompt:
An argument repeats one point five times but never addresses the obvious objection. This structure is:
A) ineffective, because it ignores the counterargument
B) highly effective
C) perfectly balanced
items.answer: A) ineffective, because it ignores the counterargument

steps: Repetition + no rebuttal. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) ineffective, because it ignores the counterargument

items.prompt:
To EVALUATE a structure means to:
A) judge how well it makes points clear, convincing, and engaging
B) only name it
C) count its paragraphs
items.answer: A) judge how well it makes points clear, convincing, and engaging

solution.answer: A) judge how well it makes points clear, convincing, and engaging

items.prompt:
Two reports argue the same recommendation. One opens with its recommendation and supports it; the other hides it in a wandering narrative. The FIRST is more effective because its structure:
A) orients the reader and builds a clear, convincing case
B) hides the recommendation longer
C) adds more words
items.answer: A) orients the reader and builds a clear, convincing case

steps: Clear structure = effective. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) orients the reader and builds a clear, convincing case

items.prompt:
Evaluating the effectiveness of a text's structure means asking whether it:
A) makes the points clear, convincing, and engaging
B) uses the most words
C) has the oldest sources
items.answer: A) makes the points clear, convincing, and engaging

solution.answer: A) makes the points clear, convincing, and engaging
